requirements.owner_answer: OD-11 — APPROVED: Unplaced orphans join the bandit clan. Guardianship order: 1. Surviving parent. 2. Living grandparents. 3. Nearest eligible blood relative. 4. Another villager's household willing and able to take the child. If no suitable household can take the child, the child joins the bandit clan. This is the intended fallback, not an indefinite temporary-care state and not a formal orphanage or adoption process. Preserve the child's identity, age, genealogy, and existing relationships. Joining the bandit clan does not instantly make a child an adult or grant adult combat abilities. Integrate this with the planned bandit-faction system. If bandit clans are not yet implemented, document the dependency and create a safe interim handling mechanism without inventing a fully functioning bandit system inside Build 15. (docs/directives/2026-10-20_owner_answers_OD11_OD12_OD13.md)

history.why: Round 1 on wip/expansion19-preparation (e05d367): memory with provenance, signed opinions, need-vs-opinion weighting (iron example both ways), gossip, provisional save section, live hooks off by default; judgment_test 99, judgment_live_test 26, judgment_perf 10 checks; gate identical with judgment off; 10-day sim with judgment on: no leaks. Not ready for live use: SJD-Q01,Q02,Q06,Q07,Q08,Q10,Q11,Q14 block it; daily update over phone frame budget (round 2 in progress)

Round 2 (693e0c3): daily update spread over 24 hourly slices with identical results; packed records cut memory at 500 people to 4.0 MB live / 16.1 MB stress; trade hook cost +5% (from +20%) with identical choices; suites pass, gate identical with judgment off. Open: gossip frame cost at 500 people (~76 ms on the assumed phone), round 3 in progress; SJD-Q01,02,06,07,08,10,11,14 still block live use

Round 3 (6615da4): gossip spread over ticks with catch-up on read, identical results proven (1,933 tellings, 252 beliefs, same end hash); 500 people live rate p99 0.87 ms (about 3.5 ms phone), p99.9 2.15 ms (about 8.6 ms phone): budget met 99 frames in 100, not 999 in 1000; memory 6.1 MB at 500 live; live village cost within noise; suites pass, gate identical when off. Paused pending a real phone measurement and the owner's choice X19-Q-TIMING; SJD-Q01,02,06,07,08,10,11,14 still block live use

Round 4 (1b05da0): the eight owner SJD decisions implemented and tested (fading and permanent judgment parts, murder never fades; trust from Relations regard; no hop limit with dedupe; personal morality separate from law; no numbers in the UI; permanent memories); judgment wired into six existing decision points (selling, timber buying, hiring, taking work, friendship, courtship), each off by default and tested both ways; judgment_test 164, judgment_live_test 53, judgment_decay_demo 24, judgment_perf 23 and the regression suites 0 failures; gate identical when off; 10-day run with judgment on: no leaks. 500-villager p99 frame 1.45 ms (about 5.8 ms on the assumed phone, over the 4 ms target; an identical-results lazy-decay fix is available, not applied per the owner's no-more-optimisation instruction). Open owner questions X19-DECAY, X19-HARMED, X19-CRT12, X19-GUARD, X19-REGARD, X19-ASSAULT

SYNC-17: Expansion 19 merged Build 17 cd7439c one way (merge 93c107f, head e91d903): conflicts only where both sides added lines (world.gd, economy_sim.gd, tests.yml), kept both; judgment hooks fire on Build 17's level-aware witness and shared-hours paths; collapse deaths publish no judged event (accidents); contract breach/acceptance feeds and collapse-death memory deferred to reconciliation. judgment_test 164, judgment_live 53, decay_demo 24, world 339, run_tests 3544, equip 51, contracts 138, conservation 8, wiki all 0 failures; 30-day seed 1 judgment on: leaks 0; gossip ~24 ms per day (not worse); frame p99 1.41 ms. Determinism gate not rerun on the branch. Ready to resume

Gossip performance round (b2eb3f9 code, 05adc9d docs): reads skip flushes that cannot change them (cached by a version counter), lazy ledger decay, no idle interpretation dictionary, direct tie reads. 500 people: live p99 1.27->1.05 ms, p99.9 3.35->1.81 ms, update 11.6->4.0 ms/day, flushes 391->29; heavy p99 8.19->6.20 ms, p99.9 15.77->13.82, update 38.4->11.3. Worst single frame unchanged (live ~6 ms desktop, ~25 ms phone estimate; heavy ~26 ms, ~105 ms phone) - an identical-result dependency flush; only the scheduled timing (owner X19-Q-TIMING, pending) bounds it. Heavy memory 17.4 MB over the proposed 16 MB budget (17.2 before). Determinism: judgment state hashes and 30-day seed-1 fingerprint 1c755f53 identical; no leaks; judgment suites pass

Investigation round (3039436 harness, c47f497 code, c4b10e4 docs): heavy-rate memory 16.9 -> 13.5 MB (opinions packed into two arrays per villager), live 5.7 -> 3.6 MB; worst frame not reducible byte-identically (107/188 tellings, ~6.6/23 ms desktop, ~25/90 ms phone); X19-Q-TIMING proposal written (docs/expansion19/GOSSIP_TIMING_PROPOSAL.md on the branch): variants A hour (today), B scheduled (prototype; save hazard), C ordered (not built); recommendation keep hour until Gate E, then build and measure C. Determinism: judgment state hashes and 30-day seed-1 fingerprint identical; suites pass. Owner decisions: X19-Q-TIMING, native code for the flush, memory budgets (16 MB heavy, proposed ~8 MB live)

requirements.description: When the village buys food from a settlement, may the settlement's sellers sell food its own households will need (the market decides), or do they release only a surplus above their own households' needs?
requirements.owner_wording: REG-BUY-D1: APPROVED IN PRINCIPLE. (docs/directives/2026-10-23_regional_economy_decisions.md)
requirements.owner_answer: APPROVED IN PRINCIPLE. Settlements may sell food to the village and other settlements. Their willingness and quantity offered should account for household consumption, reserves, expected production, and economic necessity. Do not impose an absolute prohibition on selling needed food. Settlements must retain economic agency and may make unfavorable decisions when circumstances justify them. Use existing NPC economic decision mechanisms where applicable. Present any major new selling-policy rules for approval before implementing them.

requirements.title: Settlement food-selling policy (REG-BUY-01), owner approved: (1) the traders also carry food bought from their settlement's farms, herds and cookshop; (2) a settlement releases only food above its local claim: its households' foreseeable need over reserve_days less their pantries and less the food its businesses expect to produce (World.necessity, NPCBrain._sale_stock: local buyers first); (3) a food-producing business with a demonstrated cash shortfall for essential operating expenses (wages, seeds, animal feed or other established necessities, from existing expense mechanisms) may sell into its necessity reserve, limited to that shortfall; (4) the settlement's own floating prices
requirements.description: Settlement food-selling policy (for REG-BUY-01), from the village's existing mechanisms: (1) the traders also carry food bought from their settlement's farms, herds and cookshop; (2) a settlement releases only food above its local claim: its households' foreseeable need over reserve_days less what their pantries hold and less the food its businesses expect to produce over those days (World.necessity and NPCBrain._sale_stock, local buyers first); (3) economic necessity: a food business whose till cannot pay its wages due may sell into the local claim up to that cash shortfall; prices stay the settlement's own floating prices, so scarcity raises them
requirements.owner_wording: REG-BUY-P1: APPROVED with one adjustment. ... A food-producing business may sell into its normal necessity reserve when it has a demonstrated cash shortfall for essential operating expenses, including wages, seeds, animal feed, or other established necessities. Limit those exceptional sales to the demonstrated shortfall. Do not permit unrestricted liquidation of protected food reserves. Use existing business expense and necessity mechanisms. Do not invent new expense categories or arbitrary balance numbers.
acceptance: A settlement offers food only above its households' foreseeable need over reserve_days less pantries and less expected production, computed by the same rule as World.necessity

A food-producing business sells into that reserve only with a demonstrated cash shortfall for essential operating expenses drawn from existing expense mechanisms (wages, seeds, feed or other established necessities), and no more than the shortfall
Prices are the settlement's own floating prices; no new balance numbers or expense categories
Settlements may still decide badly and suffer shortage or decline; nothing rescues them; coins and goods conserved; deterministic; tests

requirements.owner_wording: The owner also approves stonecutting as a legitimate independent profession and business, comparable to blacksmithing or carpentry. ... Professional stonecutters must participate in the ordinary village economy. They do not receive free materials, guaranteed customers, artificial sales, privileged access to deposits, or automatic profits. A stonecutter's business is allowed to succeed, struggle, or fail according to actual economic conditions. ... The full professional stonecutter career and business implementation is approved for Expansion 18, not Build 17.
requirements.description: Professional stonecutter: an independent trade and business that dresses and sells building blocks
requirements.approval: Owner directive 2026-10-21 sections 3-5: approved for Expansion 18, not Build 17
acceptance: Acquires raw stone by mining, quarrying or voluntary purchase; dresses it by the same recipe, tool, station, skill and conservation as everyone (Build 17 STONE-01 dress_stone)

Keeps a workshop and real stock of stone, tools and blocks; sells to individuals, builders, businesses and the manor; takes negotiated orders for quantities (general procurement contracts, CON-01/CON-02)

Production and buying decided by real demand, stock, prices, skill and circumstances; may hire help through the existing labour and procurement systems; no free materials, guaranteed customers or profits; may fail

No invented fixed ratio, wage, price or speed without grounding in existing systems or an owner decision; focused tests for production, conservation, tool wear, NPC capability, transfers and economic behaviour
Expansion 19 adds no second stonecutting profession; its judgment may influence stonecutters through shared NPC decision logic
requirements.notes: Dependencies also on Build 17 entries not yet on staging: STONE-01 (dress_stone recipe, building_block), STONE-02 (villagers dressing for their own use, Expansion 18), CON-01/CON-02 (procurement and service contracts), the one capability evaluator (PROS-18 adapter to MIN-D, Q18-9) and ordinary market transactions. Not implemented. Not a Build 17 release blocker. The Expansion 18 worker may assess integration during its current work without interrupting the simulations or courier work.
